items.heading: 2025 City Council Referral Prioritization Process Using Re-Weighted Range Voting (RRV)
items.action: Action: 11 speakers. M/S/C (Tregub/O’Keefe) to: 1. Approve the removal of referrals that have been nominated for removal by the Council as revised to retain the following referrals as part of the Referral Prioritization Process: • Adding BMC Chapter 13.107, Helping Achieve Responsible Development with Healthcare and Apprenticeship Training Standards (HARD HATS) Ordinance (ID# DMND0004099); • Budget Referral: No Right on Red Signs (ID# DMND0004059); • Prioritizing Pedestrians at Intersections (ID# DMND0002584); • Berkeley Food Utility and Access Resilience Measure (FARM) (ID# DMND0004109); • Adopt Berkeley Municipal Code Chapter 13.89: Community/Tenant Opportunity to Purchase Act (ID# DMND0004197); and • Planning Commission Referral for a Pilot Density Bonus Program for the Telegraph Avenue Commercial District to Generate Revenue to House the Homeless and Extremely Low-Income Individuals (ID# DMND0004188). 2. Direct the City Manager to run the ranking algorithm and return to Council with a final ranked list of referrals for adoption. Vote: All Ayes.
